name: TRUSS Email Triage MCP — Agentic Inbox Management
description: Agentic email triage for AI agents. Connect to Gmail to classify messages, extract action items, auto-label, search, and manage your inbox — all from your AI agent. Classification runs locally with no external AI APIs required.

bearer.description: TRUSS license key — required for Gmail connectivity

skills.name: Email Classification
skills.description: Classify emails by type (newsletter, transactional, personal, work, spam) using local rule-based pattern matching
examples: Classify all unread emails in my inbox by category

skills.name: Task Extraction
skills.description: Extract action items, deadlines, and follow-up tasks from email threads
examples: Extract all action items from my unread emails this week

skills.name: Auto-Label
skills.description: Automatically apply Gmail labels to emails based on classification rules and patterns
examples: Auto-label all newsletter emails with the 'Newsletter' label

skills.name: Email Search
skills.description: Search Gmail messages using Gmail query syntax with structured result output
examples: Search for emails from boss@company.com with attachments in the past month

skills.name: Inbox Triage
skills.description: Full inbox triage — classify, prioritize, and summarize unread emails in a single pass
examples: Triage my inbox and give me a prioritized summary of what needs attention today
